_doc: Inventory rules (W2-INV, durango-prompts 05). stacking_categories: item categories that keep their items.json stack_max (spec 05:3 'allow configurable category-specific stacking (currency in a wallet, certain consumables if needed)'); every other item is one instance per slot. pocket_slots_per_level: bag slots per level of a worn item's pocket attribute (spec 05:11 'Pocket attribute +6 spaces per level'); max_pocket_level caps a saved value. rarity_order: items.json rarity, least valuable first; the last tie-break of a default craft pick, after traits, level and age (spec 05:23 'protect valuable items from default auto-consumption'). Read by scripts/items/item_def.gd.
